# AccessiKit — EU EAA & French RGAA v5 Accessibility Auditor

> Zero-dependency GitHub Action, Node.js 20/22+ CLI, and 100 % client-side HTML Accessibility Auditor + Official EAA / French RGAA v5 Accessibility Declaration Generator (Directive (EU) 2019/882, in force since 28 June 2025).

## Free Tools & GitHub Marketplace

- [Browser-Side HTML Accessibility Auditor & RGAA Declaration Generator](https://yannabadie.github.io/accessikit-eaa-rgaa/): Runs 12 automated WCAG 2.1 AA / EAA / RGAA v5 checks locally in the browser with zero server upload.
- [GitHub Marketplace Action (`yannabadie/accessikit-eaa-rgaa@v1.0.0`)](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/accessikit-eaa-rgaa-v5-accessibility-auditor): Structural accessibility CI gate for static HTML builds (`dist/`).
- [XML Sitemap](https://yannabadie.github.io/accessikit-eaa-rgaa/sitemap.xml)
